behavioral_concerns: follow up: Sources map is inaccurate when a list is cleared via empty scalar value in workspace file

evidence.summary: loadFile list-clear branches at 212-220 and 254-259 call clearListField then continue without e.Sources[field]='workspace', while list-item and scalar branches at 229-231 and 263 assign workspace source
listConfigField/clearListField enumerate the 5 affected list fields (agentwrap.required_health, agentwrap.required_capabilities, agentwrap.extra_args, agentwrap.env, smoke.environment) at 553-575
config_test.go covers non-empty list loads and precedence but contains no test that clears a list to empty via empty scalar and asserts Sources==workspace, confirming testing gap for contract-testing

theories.claim: Sources map remains 'default' after workspace ultraplan.yml clears a list field via empty scalar value (e.g., 'smoke.environment: ""', 'smoke.environment:', 'agentwrap.extra_args:', 'agentwrap.env:') because loadFile clears the slice but does not set Sources[field]='workspace'
theories.basis: Static inspection of internal/platform/config/config.go:197-269 loadFile shows two list-clear paths both call clearListField then continue without assigning Sources, while every other workspace mutation assigns 'workspace' (lines 229-231 for list items, line 263 for scalars). The follow-up behavioral concern exactly matches this omission.
theories.verification_surface: internal/platform/config/config.go:197-269 loadFile, internal/platform/config/config.go:553-575 listConfigField/clearListField, internal/platform/config/config.go:153-179 Load Sources initialization, internal/platform/config/config_test.go: absence of empty-list-clear test
theories.confirmation_condition: Either clear branch (indented header 'field:' at 212-220 or empty-value 'field: ""' at 254-259) executes clearListField and continues without e.Sources[field]='workspace', leaving an empty/nil Config slice whose source is still 'default' despite being mutated by workspace file
theories.refutation_condition: If both clear branches assigned e.Sources[field]='workspace' before continue, or if clearListField were never reached for empty scalar values, Sources would correctly reflect workspace origin
theories.inconclusive_condition: If YAML parsing in production never uses the empty-scalar form to clear lists (e.g., caller ensures list fields only via dash items) or if a post-load correction elsewhere updates Sources, the inaccuracy would not manifest despite the code gap visible in these files
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only inspection of config.go loadFile branches vs Sources assignments elsewhere; compare with config_test.go coverage for list fields (TestLoadAgentwrapListThenScalarFields only tests non-empty lists, no test clears to empty); no shell, write, or mutation

theories.outcome_reason: Both branches are provably missing the assignment: 1) indented header path at 212-220: if listConfigField(field) { clearListField(&e.Config,field); listField=field; continue } — no Sources update; 2) empty-value path at 254-259: if value=="" && listConfigField(field) { clearListField(&e.Config,field); listField=field; continue } — no Sources update. List item appends at 227-242 do set Sources[listField]='workspace', so a clear-to-empty with zero subsequent '- ' items never updates Sources. This leaves smoke.environment, agentwrap.extra_args, agentwrap.env, agentwrap.required_health, agentwrap.required_capabilities stale at 'default' after workspace clear, matching the concern.
